problem: A transversal producing equal alternate angles implies that its two distinct straight lines are parallel.

proof_idea.original: If the lines met, an alternate angle would be an exterior angle of the resulting triangle, contradicting I.16.
proof_idea.analytic: Equal normalized dots and opposite determinant signs yield opposite scaled ray vectors. Their directions are parallel and the transversal gives nonzero separation; the checked forward bridge identifies actual disjoint infinite lines.

# Book I.27: equal alternate angles force two distinct lines to be parallel.
# p,q are the transversal intersections; a,b are on its opposite sides.
# Euclid excludes intersection using I.16. The analytic route combines equal
# normalized dots and opposite determinant signs to show antiparallel rays.
thm proposition_27:
    ? forall p, q, a, b cart(R, R):
        p != q
        p != a
        q != b
        $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(a, p, q, p, q, b)
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(p, a))*geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) < 0
        =>:
            $parallel::are_parallel_lines(p, a, q, b)
    have u cart(R, R) = geometry::main::vec(p, a)
    have v cart(R, R) = geometry::main::vec(q, b)
    have w cart(R, R) = geometry::main::vec(p, q)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(p, a)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(q, b)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(p, q)
    u(1) = a(1)-p(1)
    u(2) = a(2)-p(2)
    v(1) = b(1)-q(1)
    v(2) = b(2)-q(2)
    w(1) = q(1)-p(1)
    w(2) = q(2)-p(2)
    have n1 R = geometry::main::dot(w, u)
    have n2 R = geometry::main::dot(w, v)
    have d1 R = geometry::main::det(w, u)
    have d2 R = geometry::main::det(w, v)
    d1 = geometry::main::det(w, u) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(p, a))
    d2 = geometry::main::det(w, v) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(q, b))
    d1*d2 = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(p, a))*geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) < 0
    release thm geometry::main::dot_coordinate_formula(w, u)
    release thm geometry::main::dot_coordinate_formula(w, v)
    release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(w, u)
    release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(w, v)
    n1 = w(1)*u(1)+w(2)*u(2)
    n2 = w(1)*v(1)+w(2)*v(2)
    d1 = w(1)*u(2)-w(2)*u(1)
    d2 = w(1)*v(2)-w(2)*v(1)
    release thm geometry::main::dot_symmetric(u, w)
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(a, p, q) = geometry::main::dot(u, w) = geometry::main::dot(w, u) = n1
    release thm geometry::main::perpendicular_dot_expand(q, p, q, b)
    p(1)-q(1) = -(q(1)-p(1)) = -w(1)
    p(2)-q(2) = -(q(2)-p(2)) = -w(2)
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, b) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(q, p), geometry::main::vec(q, b))
    geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(q, p), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) = (p(1)-q(1))*(b(1)-q(1))+(p(2)-q(2))*(b(2)-q(2))
    (p(1)-q(1))*(b(1)-q(1))+(p(2)-q(2))*(b(2)-q(2)) = (-w(1))*v(1)+(-w(2))*v(2) = -(w(1)*v(1)+w(2)*v(2)) = -n2
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, b) = -n2
    release thm geometry::main::det_antisymmetric(w, u)
    geometry::main::det(u, w) = -(geometry::main::det(w, u)) = -d1
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(p, q)) = geometry::main::det(u, w)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(p, q)) = -d1
    release thm geometry::main::collinear_det_expand(q, p, b)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(q, p), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) = (p(1)-q(1))*(b(2)-q(2))-(p(2)-q(2))*(b(1)-q(1))
    (p(1)-q(1))*(b(2)-q(2))-(p(2)-q(2))*(b(1)-q(1)) = (-w(1))*v(2)-(-w(2))*v(1) = -(w(1)*v(2)-w(2)*v(1)) = -d2
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(q, p), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) = -d2
    release thm angles::angle_den_positive(a, p, q)
    release thm angles::angle_den_positive(p, q, b)
    release thm angles::angle_den_nonnegative(a, p, q)
    release thm angles::angle_den_nonnegative(p, q, b)
    have r1 R+ = sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q))
    have r2 R+ = sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b))
    r1^2 = sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q))^2 = geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q)
    r2^2 = sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b))^2 = geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b)
    release thm angle_measure::angle_relation_implies_equal_cosine(a, p, q, p, q, b)
    angles::angle_cosine(a, p, q) = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(a, p, q)/sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q)) = n1/r1
    angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b) = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, b)/sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b)) = -n2/r2
    n1/r1 = -n2/r2
    n1*r2 = ((n1/r1)*r1)*r2 = ((-n2/r2)*r1)*r2 = -n2*r1
    release thm geometry::main::congruent_angle_det_square_ratio(a, p, q, p, q, b)
    release thm geometry::main::square_neg(d1)
    release thm geometry::main::square_neg(d2)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(p, q))^2 = (-d1)^2 = d1^2
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(q, p), geometry::main::vec(q, b))^2 = (-d2)^2 = d2^2
    d1^2*geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(p, q))^2*geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b)
    d2^2*geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(q, p), geometry::main::vec(q, b))^2*geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q)
    d1^2*geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b) = d2^2*geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q)
    d1^2*r2^2 = d1^2*geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b) = d2^2*geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q) = d2^2*r1^2
    (d1*r2)^2 = d1^2*r2^2 = d2^2*r1^2 = (-d2*r1)^2
    -(d1*d2) > 0
    r1*r2 > 0
    (d1*r2)*(-d2*r1) = -(d1*d2)*(r1*r2) > 0
    (d1*r2)*(-d2*r1) >= 0
    release thm angle_measure::same_square_and_sign_gives_equality(d1*r2, -d2*r1)
    have zx R = r2*u(1)+r1*v(1)
    have zy R = r2*u(2)+r1*v(2)
    w(1)*zx+w(2)*zy = w(1)*(r2*u(1)+r1*v(1))+w(2)*(r2*u(2)+r1*v(2))
    w(1)*(r2*u(1)+r1*v(1))+w(2)*(r2*u(2)+r1*v(2)) = r2*(w(1)*u(1)+w(2)*u(2))+r1*(w(1)*v(1)+w(2)*v(2))
    r2*(w(1)*u(1)+w(2)*u(2))+r1*(w(1)*v(1)+w(2)*v(2)) = r2*n1+r1*n2
    r2*n1+r1*n2 = n1*r2+n2*r1 = (-n2*r1)+n2*r1 = 0
    w(1)*zx+w(2)*zy = 0
    w(1)*zy-w(2)*zx = w(1)*(r2*u(2)+r1*v(2))-w(2)*(r2*u(1)+r1*v(1))
    w(1)*(r2*u(2)+r1*v(2))-w(2)*(r2*u(1)+r1*v(1)) = r2*(w(1)*u(2)-w(2)*u(1))+r1*(w(1)*v(2)-w(2)*v(1))
    r2*(w(1)*u(2)-w(2)*u(1))+r1*(w(1)*v(2)-w(2)*v(1)) = r2*d1+r1*d2
    r2*d1+r1*d2 = d1*r2+d2*r1 = (-d2*r1)+d2*r1 = 0
    w(1)*zy-w(2)*zx = 0
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(p, q)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(p, q)
    w(1)^2+w(2)^2 = (q(1)-p(1))^2+(q(2)-p(2))^2 = geometry::main::distance_sq(p, q) > 0
    release thm geometry::main::dot_det_eliminate(w(1), w(2), zx, zy)
    r1*v(1) = (r2*u(1)+r1*v(1))-r2*u(1) = zx-r2*u(1)
    v(1) = (r1*v(1))/r1 = (zx-r2*u(1))/r1 = (0-r2*u(1))/r1 = -r2*u(1)/r1
    r1*v(2) = (r2*u(2)+r1*v(2))-r2*u(2) = zy-r2*u(2)
    v(2) = (r1*v(2))/r1 = (zy-r2*u(2))/r1 = (0-r2*u(2))/r1 = -r2*u(2)/r1
    release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(u, v)
    geometry::main::det(u, v) = u(1)*v(2)-u(2)*v(1) = u(1)*(-r2*u(2)/r1)-u(2)*(-r2*u(1)/r1) = 0
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) = geometry::main::det(u, v) = 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_parallel(p, a, q, b)
    by contra:
        ? d1 != 0
        d1 = 0
        d1*d2 = 0*d2 = 0
        impossible d1*d2 < 0
    by contra:
        ? geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(p, q)) != 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(p, q)) = 0
        d1 = -(-(d1)) = -(geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(p, q))) = -0 = 0
        impossible d1 != 0
    by def $parallel::are_parallel_lines(p, a, q, b)
